problem_statement:
feat(evolve): Phase 2 — the evolution engine (AGENT.md mutation, v1)

Adds propose -> gate -> promote/reject for the harness's own operating
principles (AGENT.md): the first thing that acts on Phase 1's bench
numbers instead of just producing them.

- src/wells/evolve/mutate.py: MutationManifest (mirrors fleet.py's
  manifest pattern), propose_mutation (candidate from a file, zero LLM
  cost, or --auto: one real headless run drafts a candidate seeded with
  recent bench failures), gate_mutation (baseline vs. candidate bench
  passes over a split, using $WELLS_PRINCIPLES to isolate the one
  variable that changes between them, plus a free replay pass over the
  trace corpus), promote_mutation (writes to <workspace>/AGENT.md,
  clears the principles cache), reject_mutation.
- src/wells/evolve/runner.py: threads an optional extra_env through
  _run_harness/_execute_task/run_bench so gate_mutation can pin
  WELLS_PRINCIPLES per bench pass without mutating this process's own
  environment (only passed when set, so existing test stubs with a
  narrower _run_harness signature keep working unchanged).
- src/wells/main.py: `wells evolve propose|gate|list|show|promote|reject`
  CLI, dispatched alongside bench/fleet/schedule.
- tests/test_evolve_mutate.py: 15 new tests, fully stubbed (no LLM calls).

Scope for v1: AGENT.md only, not tools/skills — it already has a clean,
unused write seam ($WELLS_PRINCIPLES is the top-precedence resolution
step in principles.py) and is the highest-leverage surface (governs every
agent node). Skills already have their own propose/accept/reject flow
(skill_authoring.py); tool descriptions are hardcoded Python literals
with no data-driven override yet — both left for a future extension of
this same shape.

Known, inherited limitation: the corpus has 0 val-split tasks today (10
total tasks, deterministic hash split). `gate` defaults to --split val
and fails loudly with the exact remediation rather than silently falling
back to train.

Verified end-to-end with a real gate run (single task, bounded 10-min
timeout per pass, zai profile): baseline vs. candidate bench passes both
resolved, replay ran over the trace corpus, recommendation computed
correctly, no orphaned sandbox containers. Full suite: 1019 passed, 23
skipped, 0 failed.
